title: ShieldReduce: Fine-Grained Shielded Data Reduction
problem: Shielded execution environments (TEEs) have limited protected memory capacity and security isolation overhead. Reducing data footprint within these secure enclaves while maintaining confidentiality and security properties presents a fundamental challenge.
motivation: Efficiently managing memory-constrained shielded execution is essential for scaling secure applications to handle larger datasets without prohibitive performance penalties.
method: ShieldReduce likely implements selective data reduction techniques operating at fine-grained granularity within secure execution contexts. The approach probably combines compression, deduplication, or pruning mechanisms with secure memory management to reduce data volume while preserving encryption and isolation guarantees of the TEE.
key_novelty: Applying fine-grained data reduction operations within shielded/encrypted execution environments without compromising security properties.
contributions: Fine-grained data reduction framework for shielded execution
Techniques for secure compression and pruning within TEEs
Memory efficiency improvements in confidential computing
limitations: Specific technical mechanisms, hardware targets, workload details, and evaluation baselines cannot be reliably determined from title alone.
primary_theme: Secure data reduction in confidential computing
